title: In-App Event Taxonomy Spec
deck: The event spec that defines your core business funnel as a single source of truth (SSOT). It underpins network optimization signals, cohort analysis, and LTV validation — name, parameters, and firing timing are all standardized.
summary: This taxonomy compresses a 7-stage funnel (Install → Activate → Convert → Retain → Refer → Monetize → Reactivate) into 12 Tier-1 events. Every event enforces snake_case naming, lowercase English, and a verb+noun or noun+state structure. Tier-1 events feed network optimization signals (UAC/AAP/ASA tCPA) and SKAN Conversion Value mapping — changing them arbitrarily discards campaign learning data and forces retraining.

items: snake_case enforced: addToCart (✗) → add_to_cart (✓). No mixing camel/Pascal/kebab case
Verb+noun or noun+state: prefer product_view over view_product (GA4-standard alignment)

Avoid reserved event names: session_start, first_open, in_app_purchase and other Adjust/Firebase reserved names can't be self-defined. Send revenue through a purchase event so Adjust's in_app_purchase maps automatically
Absolutely no PII: never send email, phone, name, address, or device_token directly. If needed, hash (SHA-256) + salt before sending
currency is ISO 4217 3-letter (KRW, USD, JPY). Don't normalize revenue to a single currency client-side — always send the currency parameter alongside

items: v{major}.{minor} format. Adding/removing a Tier-1 event bumps major; adding a parameter bumps minor
Deprecation policy: keep a 60-day dual-write window, then stop sending the old event. Network optimization models need retraining on the new event
Change requests go only through the Taxonomy Change Request template in the Notion DB. Requires sign-off from Growth Lead + Data Eng + iOS/Android Leads

content.title: Revenue always reports as 0 in network dashboards
content.html: 1) currency missing before the setRevenue call. 2) The event token isn't checked as a Revenue Event in the Adjust dashboard. 3) FX conversion missing when client currency and network reporting currency differ. Recommend unifying every network's reporting currency to a single KRW or USD.

content.title: Duplicate purchase events inflate ROAS
content.html: StoreKit/Play Billing payment callbacks retry and re-send the same transaction. Force-map transaction_id to Adjust's orderId and delegate dedup to the SDK. Also gate the client so the event only fires after server-side receipt validation completes.

content.title: A UAC tCPA campaign never exits the learning phase
content.html: With fewer than ~30 Tier-1 event firings per week, machine learning can't converge. If volume is short, temporarily switch the conversion definition to an upper-funnel event (purchase → add_to_cart or begin_checkout) to build learning volume, then switch back.

content.title: PII leaked into a parameter
content.html: Emails/phone numbers sneak into product_id, or free-text lands in search_keyword. Before release, scan Adjust raw exports with regex filters (@, 010, +). If found, hash or remove the parameter immediately and start the network-side data deletion process.
